Global Impact Investing

ESG Today2026-09-28

NYC Comptroller to propose $5 billion in new private-markets climate investments

NYC Comptroller Mark Levine plans to bring $5 billion of private-market climate deals to the NYCERS, TRS and BERS pension boards, spanning renewables, grids and building decarbonization. The ~$300 billion city pensions target $37.8 billion in climate investments by 2035 and net zero by 2040.

Vocabulary
  • climate solutions investinginvesting in assets that deliver solutions to climate change
  • fiduciary review processesthe formal checks trustees run to meet their fiduciary duty
  • resilient energy infrastructureenergy assets built to withstand shocks such as extreme weather

J.P. Morgan Natural Capital and Paraguay launch $200 million sustainable forestry platform

J.P. Morgan Natural Capital is partnering with Paraguay's Office of the President and local group Grupo Robinson on a roughly $200 million forestry platform combining commercial plantations, native forest restoration, timber and carbon credits. Deployment is due to start in early 2027, reflecting nature's rise as an institutional asset class.

Vocabulary
  • nature-based assetsincome-producing assets rooted in nature, such as forests
  • carbon creditstradable certificates for verified emission cuts or removals
  • native forest restorationrebuilding degraded forests with local native species

Crédit Agricole launches natural capital division; Amundi targets €200 million forest restoration fund

Crédit Agricole set up a Natural Capital division, Crédit Agricole Capital Naturel, headed by Timothée Jaulin and first focused on European forests. Its asset manager Amundi launched Amundi Arbora Nova, aiming to raise €200 million over time for forest restoration, and the group is in exclusive talks to buy a majority of EcoTree.

Achmea and ILX team up on an emerging-markets debt impact platform for Dutch pensions

Achmea Investment Management and ILX Management are building an emerging-markets debt impact vehicle for Dutch pension funds, mainly holding loans originated by multilateral development banks and DFIs with explicit impact goals in climate, biodiversity, health and equality. Size was not disclosed; it is a model for linking public and private capital.

General Atlantic-owned Actis launched Leo Energies in India, aiming for a portfolio of over 3GW of wind, solar and storage. It has agreed to buy about 650MWp of operating solar across five states under long-term PPAs, marking Actis's fourth Indian renewables platform built through a buy-and-build approach.

TPG has raised $10 billion for TPG Rise Climate II, which was due to close to new money at end-September, Bloomberg reported. UAE-backed Alterra committed around $1 billion. The Rise Climate platform had $17.1 billion in total commitments as of August, a sign large LPs still back the energy transition.

ESG Today2026-09-30

UK FCA drops mandatory IFRS-based climate reporting in favour of comply-or-explain

The FCA scrapped plans to make climate disclosures mandatory for UK listed companies, applying comply-or-explain to all UK SRS S1 and S2 requirements while keeping Scope 3 relief. Rules cover periods from 1 January 2027, with first reports in 2028, which may leave investors with patchier climate data.

Vocabulary
  • comply-or-explainfollow the rule or publicly explain why not
  • Scope 3 reportingreporting indirect emissions across the value chain
  • decision-usefulinformation that actually helps investors make decisions

Vietnam becomes GSG Impact's 44th National Partner and 13th in Asia Pacific

Vietnam Impact Alliance became GSG Impact's 44th National Partner and the 13th in Asia Pacific, taking the GSG Impact Partnership to 49 countries. It will convene government, investors, business and civil society to build Vietnam's impact economy as the country seeks capital for its climate transition and inclusive growth.

Reverion raises $175 million Series B for carbon-negative-capable power plants

German fuel-cell startup Reverion raised a $175 million Series B led by Kembara, joined by Energy Impact Partners, Aurum Impact and Carbon Equity among others. Its plants reach 74.2% electrical efficiency and can deliver negative emissions with biogas and carbon storage; it plans a tenfold capacity jump to 250 MW.

Asia's EAMs turn into tech platforms, chasing B2B SaaS revenue

Asia's external asset managers (EAMs) are entering a new phase of competition, building proprietary tech platforms and offering them to others in a bid to earn B2B SaaS revenue and win market share — a shift from pure advisory toward wealth-tech services that could change how family offices pick providers.

StanChart: philanthropy is 'training wheels' for family governance

Scott Chang, Asia philanthropy head at Standard Chartered Global Private Bank, says structured giving acts as 'training wheels' for family governance and succession, helping families align before discussing wealth transfer, and argues philanthropy should not be sold as a product.

Worth2026-09-29

Family offices now outsize the global VC industry

Single-family offices oversee about $5.5 trillion (Citi Wealth puts it at $5.9-6.9 trillion), above the $1-1.5 trillion venture industry. Their number has grown over 75% since 2020 to more than 10,700, and 70% make direct investments, competing with PE and VC for deals.

Vocabulary
  • deal flowthe stream of investment opportunities an investor sees
  • co-investmentinvesting directly in a deal alongside a lead fund or sponsor
  • wealth transferpassing assets from one generation to heirs or charity
